notes.subject: check image
notes.text: build it from images/ciam-check/ (FROM mcr.microsoft.com/azurelinux/distroless/python:3.12-nonroot), sign it, verify its signature before it is used (Container Apps doesn't verify signatures), push it, and record its digest on each canary binding
how: Build the image from this build context in the organization's pipeline (pin the base image by digest: setting azure-check-image)
Sign it (the organization's signing, e.g. Notary Project signatures kept in the registry) and verify the signature by digest before promoting it; Azure Container Apps pulls whatever the job names
Push it to a registry the environment's jobs reach (a private one: allow ARM audience tokens for managed identity pulls, az acr config authentication-as-arm)

Record it on each canary binding (ciamContainerImage check=<registry>/<repository>@sha256:<digest>), under an approved change, and re-render; rebuild only when opsdir's probes change (this file's text)
notes.scope: image pipeline and registry of target/prod (crexampleaerociam.azurecr.io)

notes.subject: check jobs
notes.text: whoever may start one can override its image, command and environment and use its identity and secrets (Microsoft's jobs documentation): keep that right to identities trusted with them; the built-in Container Apps Jobs Operator and Contributor roles can also read the jobs' secrets
how: Give operators a custom role with only Microsoft.App/jobs/read, jobs/start/action, jobs/stop/action, jobs/stop/execution/action, jobs/executions/read, jobs/execution/read and Microsoft.App/managedEnvironments/read (not the Microsoft.App/jobs/*/action wildcard), assigned only to those trusted with the jobs' identities

notes.subject: subnet snet-checks
notes.text: must be delegated to Microsoft.App/environments and hold nothing else before the checks' Container Apps environment is applied
how: Have the network's keeper delegate subnet snet-checks to Microsoft.App/environments (and move anything else out of it), then apply
